Reproducible, auto-scaling AWS EKS platform provisioned 100% from Terraform, with blue/green CI/CD and Datadog tracing from day one.

A fresh AWS account can be brought to a running staging environment in under 60 minutes from `terraform apply` with zero manual console steps.

column3: Identity, Security & Compliance
column4:
h3. Goal
Centralised identity (pupils aged 11–15 in age bands A and B, parents, teachers, school admins), encryption everywhere, and compliance with Tunisian Law 2004-63 for children's data: the tutor's consent and the article 28 condition, transfers under article 52, plus GDPR-equivalent controls.

h3. Definition of Done
Counsel's opinion on articles 28 and 52 applied; data-protection impact assessment signed before the first pilot school; external penetration test passes with no High/Critical findings before the paid launch.

h3. Scope
* 14 tickets, 79 story points
* Sprints S2–S21 (Phase 1 — Data Plane & Design Research)
* Component: Security

column3: Event-Driven Telemetry & Data Warehouse
column4:

Every learner micro-interaction (slider drag, hover, hesitation, confidence, answer) is captured as a schema-versioned Kafka event and lands in Snowflake within 5 minutes and in Redis within 200 ms.

h3. Definition of Done
Sustained 50k events/sec with p99 end-to-end lag < 5 min to warehouse; zero schema-breaking deploys thanks to the registry.

h3. Scope
* 13 tickets, 81 story points
* Sprints S2–S9 (Phase 1 — Data Plane & Design Research)
* Component: Data

column3: Curriculum Knowledge Graph & Content Pipeline (multi-subject)
column4:

The 6e–9e subjects load through E13 on the same tooling; the Bac physics graph waits in phase 2.

h3. Definition of Done
Tooling supports any subject and level with zero code changes; every published item has at least one concept tag, a second reviewer and its rights recorded; maths banks calibrated on the pilot.

* 12 tickets, 89 story points
* Sprints S2–S20 (Phase 1 — Data Plane & Design Research)

column3: Deep Knowledge Tracing Core
column4:

Self-hosted SAINT+ model (pyKT) predicting per-concept failure probability, with IRT cold-start fallback, weekly automated retraining and sub-50 ms online inference.

h3. Definition of Done
AUC ≥ 0.80 on held-out Tunisian cohort data; p99 inference latency ≤ 50 ms at 2,000 RPS; weekly retrain runs unattended with automatic rollback on metric regression.

h3. Scope
* 14 tickets, 99 story points
* Sprints S1–S19 (Phase 2 — Intelligence & Pilot Build)
* Component: ML

column3: Multi-Model LLM Gateway & Guardrails

column3: As a parent or legal tutor, I give verifiable consent before my child (11–15) can use Kuizi
column4:
h3. Description
Every learner is a child, so the parent comes first: the parent or legal tutor creates the account, declares the child's birth month and year (which sets the age band, T243), proves their contact, reads the parent notice and gives each consent separately; the child then gives their assent on the screens designed in T244. The article 28 condition of Law 2004-63 (the family judge's authorisation or the school route) is whatever counsel's opinion (T242) decides, held as configuration so the flow does not change when the route is chosen. Built on synthetic data until T242 is signed.

h3. Acceptance Criteria
* No pupil account reaches learning content or sends learning events until a verified tutor consent and the article 28 condition chosen in T242 are recorded (automated test)
* The consent record holds the policy version, time, declared capacity, verification method, each separate consent and the pupil's assent; the IP address is kept only if counsel needs it as proof
* The tutor or the pupil can withdraw any consent; the affected processing stops within 1 minute and the other party is told
* "Pas maintenant" at the assent step keeps the account inactive

h3. Addendum changes (v2)
* A separate, revocable consent covers accommodation data (E14, T151)
* Rewritten for pupils aged 11–15 (ADR 0011; minors-11-15.md 5.2, MR-C1–C9): parent first, the article 28 condition from T242, assent screens from T244; 5 → 8 points; leaves Sprint 3 because counsel's opinion and the consent design come first
